analysis: The 2048-negative experiment succeeded with host macro validation HR@10=0.5312, versus the reported historical 0.530 for 512 negatives: a small improvement of 0.0012, below the hypothesized 0.535–0.545 range. Category HR@10 was Movies_and_TV 0.605, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.585, Electronics 0.425, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.510. The result provides limited evidence for stronger negative competition; one run does not establish a reliable improvement or its cause. Allocated GPU cost was 225.119 seconds. No test metrics were available or used.
code_summary: Trains one independent SASRec model per category with seed 42: 96-dimensional embeddings, two causal attention blocks, two heads, dropout 0.3, learned positions and item biases. Sampled-softmax cross-entropy uses 2048 shared uniform negatives sampled with replacement, masks target collisions at -1e4, and caps supervised tokens at 2048. Prefix sampling, AdamW, learning-rate warmup, validation checkpoint selection, and early stopping remain unchanged. Epoch default is 200. Inference routes each category to exactly one selected checkpoint; no ensembles or external scores are used.
